Type: leather throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, industrial, mid-century modern
Materials: top grain leather, piped edge
Colors: warm saddle brown, cognac
Shape: square, smooth slightly distressed surface, piped edges, boxy and full
Feel: warm, rugged, classic
Goes with: wool or linen sofas, dark wood, black metal, cream textiles; rustic, lodge or industrial rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic 100% Top Grain Leather Decorative Throw Pillow, Badlands Saddle
product.description: This handsome, sturdy leather pillow will add style and texture to a couch or chair. The rich 100% top grain leather in a saddle color gives it an outdoorsy, western flair. Beautiful natural markings in the hide make each pillow unique. 19"x 19" Full grain leather Removable polyester fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features a zipper closure Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
